review.input: Seven hash-verified reserved raw frames, with ordinary resized crops for number readability. No detector proposals, model tracks, jersey OCR or VLM predictions used.
review.frame_300: Period-title graphic: no floor participants. This interval includes an edit between periods and is not 60 seconds of continuous play.
review.identity_policy: Only independently readable numbers are recorded. Black jersey at frame 0 is 65, confirmed in its crop. Blurred numbers at frames 150 and 600 remain unknown. Equipment signature limited to two adjacent pre-edit goalie views. Cross-edit identity can be scored only when a jersey is independently readable at both ends.
review.limitations: Sparse assistant review, not independent-human or dense tracking ground truth. Body boxes are manually approximated. Same-team unreadable identities remain uncertain.

excluded.reason: Severely truncated right-edge blue participant; insufficient separable body for a useful reference box.
Officials and participants behind boards are excluded from floor-player references.

scope: New longer interval in a previously seen recording, excluded from training and selection; not a new-camera or independent-human test.
